card.name: Linking words before torsades de pointes
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation such as "such as", "e.g.,", "including" or a comma, right before torsades de pointes or ventricular arrhythmia terms. Seen in QT-prolongation warnings.

modes.label: Such as / e.g.
modes.description: The "as" in "such as" or the "e.g.," that introduces torsades de pointes as an example arrhythmia.
modes.example: may lead to life-threatening ventricular dysrhythmias such<< as>> torsades de pointes [see W

modes.label: Other links to arrhythmia
modes.description: Words like "to", "into" or "including" that lead into a ventricular arrhythmia or torsades term.
modes.example: the VT degenerated<< into>> ventricular fibrillation, requiring immediate def

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a warning names torsades de pointes or another dangerous heart rhythm.
